title: Run
description: v0.15 (verification.database: the final verification report's runs.database passed through unchanged, EXEC SQL programs only; absent otherwise) (v0.14 adds assurance, assuranceReason and cobolRepair: convert-anyway mode; a run without them is a plain certified or not-certified run, as before) (v0.13 adds behavior: verified documentation, claims about the original COBOL checked by GnuCOBOL, and its event type) (v0.12 adds tiers: model escalation by task difficulty) (v0.11 adds the guard agent: guard events and the guard result) (v0.10 adds crosscheck, the independent Muse Spark Open check, and its event type) (v0.9 the source response and the interrupted status, v0.8 visitor, v0.2 added efficiency, v0.3 memory, v0.4 status and stage events, v0.5 breaker agent and swarm, v0.6 certificationSeed and error, v0.7 the public re-verify response). One converter run as served by services/api GET /runs/{id}: provenance, the agent trace, verification before and after, model usage, and the Java diff.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601, from the run directory name

certificationSeed.description: Seed of the held-out inputs that certified the run

error.description: Set when the converter crashed, or when the run stopped cleanly because the original COBOL does not compile under GnuCOBOL and so cannot be verified; the run is then not certified

status.description: running while the converter is still working (events grow as it goes); interrupted when a running run has been silent for 30 minutes (the engine restarted or the job was stopped)

javaOrigin.description: Where the Java started: a copied conversion or a model translation

events.description: Agent trace: agent-step, certification and budget events, in order.

blocked.description: guard events: the guard stopped this Java from running or revoked its certification

before.description: Verification of the starting Java (null if not recorded)

after.description: Certification on held-out inputs (null if none)

javaDiff.description: Unified diff from the starting Java to the final Java

breaker.description: Breaker agent results after certification: designed inputs tried, how many broke the Java, whether the repair fixed them

tiers.description: Model escalation (converter --tiers, hosted mode): the repair agent moves up one tier after each failed certification round, resumes at a configured tier (default 2) when a breaker or cross-check input breaks a Java that had certified, and the breaker attacks with a configured tier (default 2). Tier 1 is the run's default model; higher tiers are other models on the same host and key, with their own hard caps (calls and dollars per run). Null when escalation was not used. Every call's model is in usage.modelCalls.

escalations.description: Each time the repair agent moved up

escalatedUsd.description: Estimated cost of the calls made above tier 1

crosscheck.description: Independent cross-check after certification: Muse Spark Open (open weights, its own host and key) designs inputs where it thinks the Java differs from the COBOL. Every case runs through GnuCOBOL and the Java, so the model's opinion certifies nothing; a mismatch goes to the repair agent. `skipped` (a reason) is set instead of the counts when it did not run.

casesValid.description: Cases that fit the input layout and were actually run

mismatches.description: Valid cases on which GnuCOBOL and the Java really differed

suspected.description: Fields the model says may diverge. An opinion, never evidence.

rejectedBecause.description: Why proposed cases did not fit the input layout, with counts

behavior.description: Verified documentation (converter --document): claims a Muse Spark model wrote about the ORIGINAL COBOL, each checked by running GnuCOBOL on its examples. Same object as contracts/behavior-claims.schema.json v0.1 (validate against that file). Optional: absent or null on runs made without --document; old runs stay valid.

swarm.description: Run picked up lessons certified by parallel agents mid-run

memory.description: Fix memory: lessons read at the start, and lessons stored after held-out certification passed. Null for runs saved before memory existed.

learned.description: Lessons new to memory from this run

visitor.description: From a visitor's import of a repository Diocle does not control: shown as the sandbox reported it, not offered for public re-verification

assurance.description: Convert-anyway mode only (absent on older runs: read `certified`). certified = differential test passed against the ORIGINAL COBOL (certified is true). certified-against-repaired-cobol = the original did not compile under GnuCOBOL -std=ibm, the COBOL was patched (see cobolRepair) and the Java passed the differential test against the PATCHED COBOL, not the original (certified is false). compiled-unverified = the Java compiles with javac, no differential test ran, a person must review it (certified is false). failed = no compiling Java within the caps (certified is false). Only `certified` may be called certified.

assuranceReason.description: Why the run is not plain certified: the analyzer's not-convertible reason, the compiler's diagnostic, or the cap that stopped it

cobolRepair.description: The original COBOL did not compile; what was changed so it does. The user's file is never overwritten: the patched COBOL is written beside it as <name>.repaired.cbl.

diagnostics.description: Cleaned compiler diagnostics that were fixed (or the last ones if it still fails)

fixes.description: One phrase per mechanical fix (deterministic) or per patch rationale (model)

guard.description: The guard agent's result. policy: deterministic checks run before any Java is executed and on the COBOL for text aimed at an AI. review: one Meta-model review of the final Java against the COBOL, on its own key (GUARD_MODEL_*), null when not configured.

blocked.description: The run ended uncertified because of the guard (review verdict block, or Java the policy would not run)

stopped.description: Times the policy refused to run the Java; the repair agent is told why and can fix it

sourceFlags.description: Text in the COBOL aimed at an AI, or other suspicious content

source.description: GET /runs/{id}/source: the original COBOL (program and copybooks) next to the run's Java, for reading side by side. Not served for visitor runs.

path.description: Relative to the sample (COBOL) or to the run's java/ directory

reverify.description: POST /runs/{id}/reverify: the run's certified Java and the original COBOL re-run on fresh random inputs. No model calls.

efficiency.description: How efficiently the agent reached its result. Derived from usage and events; costs are estimates from list prices.

cobolLines.description: Non-blank, non-comment lines of the program and its copybooks

database.description: Additive (v0.15). Copied unchanged from verification-report.json runs.database (verification-report v0.9; shape defined there). Present only for programs verified against a database.
